The '''Jagged Spire''' is a sept of the [[Taardad]] [[Aiel]].{{ref|{{twotc}}, Jagged Spire}} The sept hold is unknown. [[Aviendha]] once heard that [[Wise One]]s of the Jagged Spire and [[Four Holes]] septs could [[Healing|Heal]] using the [[One Power]]. She thought it was a boast.{{ref/book|4|39}}
